'''Sector Champion''' was the title given to the reigning [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] champion of various worlds, such as [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], during the [[Jedi Civil War]].
